title: Second Battle of Rappahannock Station
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Second Battle of Rappahannock Station", at revision 1370736544, opens: "The Second Battle of Rappahannock Station took place on November 7, 1863, near the village of Rappahannock Station, on the Orange and Alexandria Railroad." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q526697, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1863 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
